$comment: Bogi / Togi design profile. A single droppable source of truth for the brand: logo, fonts, colors, gradients, effects, motion, and copy. Hex values are computed from the live oklch theme tokens.
name: Bogi design profile

brand.name: Bogi
brand.oneLiner: A private AI accountability coach. You plan your day, and it makes you face what you actually did with each block.
brand.tagline: Take back control of your time
brand.audience: Students and ordinary people, ADHD or not. Starting in Sweden.
brand.feeling: Calm, honest, in control. You stop wondering where your day went.
brand.canonicalLook: Dreamy pastel sky + Apple frosted-glass + the soft plush axolotl. Warm and cute, never corporate or cold.
explorationsDropped: editorial / broadsheet (paper + vermilion + Instrument Serif body)

logo.description: A soft, rounded, baby-blue plush axolotl. Smiling, with three feathery gills on each side, big glossy black eyes, sitting on four little legs. Transparent background.
logo.regenPrompt: A soft plush toy axolotl, baby-blue fleece, rounded chubby body, three feathery gills on each side, big round glossy black eyes, a small embroidered smile, sitting pose, studio product photo, soft even lighting, transparent background.
logo.usage: The mascot IS the logo. It floats and gently bobs, peeking over the top edge of the glass card. Keep it cute. Do not flatten it into a corporate icon.

display.role: Headlines and big serif moments. Use italic for accent words.

mono.role: Small labels, times, meta, data readouts.

primary.role: Sky-blue accent: buttons, links, active states.

background.role: Page base color behind the sky.

sky.role: The dreamy sky background. Blue at the top warming to cream at the bottom.

clouds.role: Soft white cloud blobs layered over the sky, drifting slowly.
clouds.css: radial-gradient(40% 24% at 22% 82%, rgba(255,255,255,0.92), transparent 70%) plus 3-4 more offset radial blobs

pillButton.hover: translateY(-2px) scale(1.015), brighter, larger soft shadow

grain.role: Faint paper grain over the page for texture.

cursorGlow.role: A soft warm radial sunlight that follows the cursor.
cursorGlow.css: radial-gradient(520px circle at cursor, warm-white 52%, transparent 72%)

effects.mascotShadow: drop-shadow(0 18px 26px rgba(40,80,120,0.3)) so the plush feels like it floats

motion.principle: Smooth, gentle, Apple-like. Never snappy or harsh.
motion.heroEntrance: fade in + rise 20px + slight scale-up (0.985 to 1) + de-blur, 0.95s
motion.float: gentle vertical bob, translateY 0 to -9px, 5s ease-in-out infinite

copy.headline: Take back control of your time
copy.subline: A private AI coach that helps you plan your day, then face what you actually did with it.
copy.betaNote: Free during the beta. Starting in Sweden.
copy.companionGreeting: hey. want to know where your time actually went today?
copy.productOneLiner: Plan your day, then face what you actually did with it.

voiceRules: No em dashes. Use commas, periods, colons, or parentheses.
No generic startup filler (supercharge, unlock, effortless, level up, seamless).
Flowing, human, connected sentences, not stacked punchy fragments.
Avoid the 'it's not X, it's Y' construction.
Warm and honest, a little calm. UI labels often lowercase.

components.skyBackground: Fixed sky gradient + slow-drifting soft white cloud blobs + a cursor-following warm sun-glow.
components.glassHero: Frosted glass card (30px radius) holding the headline, subline, and pill button, with the plush axolotl peeking over the top edge for depth.
components.appleButton: Blue pill CTA with a soft inner highlight and a smooth hover lift.
components.desktopCompanion: A small floating draggable axolotl that opens a frosted chat panel which grows as you talk.
